summary: Applied the blocking review repair by making R1-R3 testable so spec-local headers can cover R1 through R4.

items.title: Test headers cannot cover requirements marked non-testable
items.rationale: Removed `testable:false` from R1-R3 because these requirements are static source-text expectations that spec-local tests can verify.
items.evidence: spec.json requirements[0], requirements[1], and requirements[2] no longer contain `testable:false`; acceptance_criteria[3] can now be satisfied by spec-local headers for R1-R4.
